description: Quiet short click — low-key UI tap / soft selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.
Quick pop — element appear/spawn, chip/tag/badge in. Small precise accent, sync to the pop-in.
Short whoosh — quick swipe/slide accent, fast element move, snappy transition. Sync to the motion.
Punchy whoosh/impact — fast reveal or hard transition accent. Sync to the motion.
Typing burst (~1.5s of keys) — keyboard / code typing reveal, text-being-typed beat. Start as the text begins typing.
Crisp UI click — button press, toggle, selection. Short accent, sync exactly to the on-screen action.
Bass impact with a short swell — brief anticipation then a deep hit. Place so the peak lands on the reveal.
